classDiagram
direction LR

class NodeInternals {
    <<final>>

    +endSourceRange(element, lineMap, startPos, endPos)$ void
    +clearEndSourceRange(element)$ void
    +sourceDataStart(pi, pos)$ void
    +attributeRange(attributes, key, lineMap, nameStart, nameEnd, valueStart, valueEnd)$ void
    +attributeRange(attributes, key, range)$ void
}

class Validate {
    <<final>>
    +notNull(obj)$
}

class LineMap {
    <<final>>
}

class Node {
    <<abstract>>
    +sourceRange() Range
    ~spans() Spans
    ~ensureSpans() Spans
}

class LeafNode {
    <<abstract>>
}

class Element {
    +endSourceRange() Range
}

class ProcessingInstruction {
    ~sourceDataStart(pos) void
}

class Attributes {
    +sourceRange(key) AttributeRange
    ~spans() Spans
    ~ensureSpans() Spans
    ~visibleIndexOfKey(key) int
}

class Range {
    +start() Position
    +end() Position
    +isTracked() boolean
    ~ofStart(node)$ Range
    ~ofEnd(element)$ Range
}

class Spans_Range["Range.Spans"] {
    <<final>>
    ~sourceRange(lineMap, startPos, endPos) void
    ~endSourceRange(lineMap, startPos, endPos) void
    ~clearEndSourceRange() void
    ~attributeRange(index) AttributeRange
    ~attributeRange(index, range) void
    ~copy() Spans
}

class AttributeRange_Range["Range.AttributeRange"] {
    +nameRange() Range
    +valueRange() Range
    +isTracked() boolean
}

class Cleaner {
    -copySafeNodes(source, dest)
}

class TreeBuilder {
    <<abstract>>
    ~lineMap() LineMap
    ~processEnd(...)
}

class HtmlTreeBuilder {
    ~insert(...)
    ~popStackToClose(...)
}

class XmlTreeBuilder {
    ~insert(...)
}

class HtmlTreeBuilderState {
    <<enum>>
    ~process(t, tb) boolean
}

class Token {
    <<abstract>>
}

class Token_Tag["Token.Tag"] {
    <<abstract>>
    ~finaliseTag() void
}

NodeInternals ..> Validate : uses
NodeInternals ..> LineMap : uses
NodeInternals ..> Node : sets range on
NodeInternals ..> Element : sets end range on

NodeInternals ..> Attributes : sets attribute range on
NodeInternals ..> Spans_Range : uses via spans()
NodeInternals ..> AttributeRange_Range : takes as parameter

%% Type hierarchy of the nodes it touches
Node <|-- LeafNode
Node <|-- Element
LeafNode <|-- ProcessingInstruction

%% Range data model
Range *-- Spans_Range : nested
Range *-- AttributeRange_Range : nested
Range ..> LineMap : uses
Spans_Range ..> LineMap : uses
Spans_Range *-- AttributeRange_Range : holds
Attributes ..> Spans_Range : holds
Node ..> Spans_Range : spans()
Node ..> Range : sourceRange()
Element ..> Range : endSourceRange()
Attributes ..> AttributeRange_Range : sourceRange()
ProcessingInstruction ..> Spans_Range : reads

XmlTreeBuilder --|> TreeBuilder

XmlTreeBuilder ..> NodeInternals : uses

Token ..> Token_Tag : nested
Token_Tag ..> NodeInternals : uses
Cleaner ..> NodeInternals : uses
